'''Fire Quartz''' is a [[Minerals|Mineral]]. It can be foraged in [[the Mines]] (floors 80+), in the [[Skull Cavern]], or found inside a [[Magma Geode]] or [[Omni Geode]].  It can also be found by [[Pans|panning]] or inside [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]]. It may occasionally be found in a [[Garbage Can]] after the player reaches floor 80 of the mines. It can also be gifted randomly by the [[Wizard]] in the mail, once the player has met him. One Fire Quartz can sometimes be purchased for {{Price|2500}} from [[Pierre]]'s booth at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]]. 

Fire Quartz can be destroyed by [[Crafting#Bombs|bombs]]. 

Fire Quartz can be used along with 1 [[coal]] in a [[furnace]] to produce 3 [[Refined Quartz]], taking 1.5 in-game hours to smelt.

==Smelting==
To smelt Fire Quartz, equip it and activate the [[furnace]] while there is [[Coal]] in inventory. One unit of Coal is required for each smelting operation, regardless of the material or duration.

==Tailoring==
Fire Quartz is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[File:Shirt057.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Shirt]]. It can also be used as a red dye color at the dye pots in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, located at [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
*Fire Quartz may be randomly requested during any season at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|300}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points.  Fire Quartz will never be requested until you have reached level 80+ of [[The Mines]].
*Three Fire Quartz are requested by [[Lava Eel]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 1 to 3.
